title: Scholarly Paper
description: Target schema for scholarly paper metadata integrated from DBLP, Crossref, and OpenAlex.

id.title: Record ID
id.description: Stable source-prefixed record identifier used by entity matching and fusion.

doi.title: DOI
doi.description: Digital Object Identifier normalized without the https://doi.org/ prefix.

type.title: Publication Type
type.description: Publication type reported by the source, such as article, inproceedings, or journal-article.

authors.title: Authors
authors.description: Ordered list of author display names.

publication_year.title: Publication Year
publication_year.description: Year in which the scholarly work was published.

journal.title: Venue
journal.description: Journal, conference, proceedings, or source display name.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Comma-separated keywords, concepts, or subject labels associated with the paper.

x-pydi-consistency.description: Keywords are open-world terms; only approximate item count is custom; length is handled by JSON Schema.

first_page.title: First Page
first_page.description: First page of the publication page range.

x-pydi-consistency.description: Numeric pages should be between 1 and 100000; article locators such as e1008483 are allowed.

last_page.title: Last Page
last_page.description: Last page of the publication page range.

x-pydi-consistency.description: Numeric pages should be between 1 and 100000, and last_page should be greater than or equal to first_page when both are numeric.

referenced_works_count.title: Referenced Works Count
referenced_works_count.description: Number of referenced works reported by the source.

cited_by_count.title: Cited By Count
cited_by_count.description: Number of citing works reported by the source.
